summary: The proposed patch addresses the length mismatch issue when wrapping data in a pandas container by checking if the lengths of the index and data_to_wrap match. This resolves the specific issue without introducing obvious regressions or compatibility problems.

issues.description: The change might introduce behavioral regression risk if there are other scenarios where the index should be set even if the lengths do not match. However, given the context and the nature of the fix, this seems unlikely.
The addition of a blank line at the top of the file does not align with the existing style conventions of the repository.
